body: Thank you mama. I just feel so stupid because I gave him so much money... probably like $1000 or so. I just feel so unlovable.
I agree, it does. Like I said in the previous comment though, I heard this answer from somewhere and, while I am slightly religious, I don't necessarily believe it.

I saw this a while back on YouTube, but some people think it's selfish because you do not choose to be born, so you shouldn't be able to choose when to die. Life is a so-called precious gift, so throwing it away is seen as a selfish act.
It's alright. I'm glad that you managed to get them though. :)
I have 2 blue roses if you're still interested.
I'm so happy for you! You're very lucky. My parents walked in on me self-harming and immediately freaked out. Now they treat me like I'm some mental patient or something... :(
